# BullFrog AI Holdings Announces 1-for-10 Reverse Stock Split


November 25, 2026 7:00 am EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_96c431d13e71c2cb8241c51d7fbbd58f/bullfrogai/news/2026-11-25_BullFrog_AI_Holdings_Announces_1_for_10_Reverse_93.pdf)


### Shares Expected to Begin Trading on a Split-Adjusted Basis on November 30, 2026


GAITHERSBURG, Md., Nov. 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- BullFrog AI Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BFRG; BFRGW) ("BullFrog AI"), an AI company using its proprietary platform to turn complex biomedical data into actionable insights, today announced that a 1-for-10 reverse stock split of BullFrog AI’s common stock, par value $0.00001 per share.


BullFrog AI’s common stock is expected to begin trading on a split-adjusted basis on The Nasdaq Capital Market (“Nasdaq”) at the market open on November 30, 2026, under the existing ticker symbol “BFRG” with the new CUSIP number 12021E307.


As a result of the reverse stock split, every 10 shares of BullFrog AI’s issued and outstanding common stock will automatically be combined into one share with no further action required from stockholders. No fractional shares will be issued in connection with the reverse stock split. Stockholders who would otherwise be entitled to a fractional share will instead receive one whole share, rounding their holdings up to the nearest whole share. Outstanding shares are expected to decrease from 18,693,280 shares as of November 12, 2026, to approximately 1.88 million, subject to fractional-share adjustments. The split will not change the par value or number of authorized shares, or stockholders’ proportional ownership, except for fractional-share treatment.


Outstanding stock options, warrants (including publicly traded warrants, BFRGW) and other convertible securities will be adjusted proportionately as to the number of underlying shares and applicable exercise or conversion prices, in accordance with their terms. Warrant exercise prices and the number of shares underlying such warrants, and shares reserved under BullFrog AI’s equity incentive plans will also be adjusted in accordance with the relevant terms.


Stockholders holding shares in book-entry form or through a broker, bank or other nominee do not need to take any action as a result of the reverse split. VStock Transfer, LLC (“VStock”), BullFrog AI’s transfer and exchange agent, will provide exchange instructions to holders of physical certificates. Stockholders with questions may contact VStock at 212-828-8436.


The reverse stock split is intended to help BullFrog AI regain compliance with Nasdaq’s $1.00 minimum bid price requirement under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). Following a deficiency notice received on February 10, 2026, Nasdaq granted BullFrog AI an additional 180-calendar-day compliance period on August 18, 2026, extending the deadline to February 8, 2027. To regain compliance, the common stock must maintain a closing bid price of at least $1.00 for a minimum of ten consecutive business days, subject to Nasdaq’s discretion to require a longer period.


**About BullFrog AI**
BullFrog AI harnesses artificial intelligence and machine learning to advance pharmaceutical R&D and drug target discovery, providing AI-accelerated outputs that are optimized and human-validated. BullFrog AI operates through three complementary capabilities, deployable independently or as a combined platform: bfPREP™ for biology-aware data harmonization, bfLEAP® for causal AI analytics and patient subgroup discovery, and bfARENAS™ for structured, auditable decision support. The common thread across all three: every output is traceable, every analytical decision is logged, and every recommendation is designed to be reviewed and validated by the scientific team before it drives a decision.
